data.description:
## Testing-mode: RED

## Objective
Add behavioral tests to tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh that fail against the current read-config.sh (which returns empty/exits 0 for dso.workflow key) and will pass once the shim is implemented.

## File Impact
- tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh — add test functions

## Test Functions to Add

### test_dso_workflow_canonical_key_returns_value
Config has `dso.workflow=ci-pr`. Call: `read-config.sh dso.workflow <config>`.
Assert: stdout == "ci-pr", exit 0.

### test_dso_workflow_canonical_local_returns_value
Config has `dso.workflow=local`. Call: `read-config.sh dso.workflow <config>`.
Assert: stdout == "local", exit 0.

### test_dso_workflow_legacy_keys_map_to_ci_pr
Config has `merge.strategy=pr` and `enforcement.strategy=ci` (no dso.workflow key).
Assert: stdout == "ci-pr", exit 0.

### test_dso_workflow_legacy_keys_map_to_local
Config has `merge.strategy=direct` (no enforcement.strategy, no dso.workflow key).
Assert: stdout == "local", exit 0.

### test_dso_workflow_missing_config_exits_nonzero
No config file exists. Call: `read-config.sh dso.workflow /nonexistent/path.conf`.
Assert: exit code != 0, stderr contains "onboarding" or "dso-config.conf".

### test_dso_workflow_emits_deprecation_warning_on_legacy_keys
Config has legacy keys only (merge.strategy + enforcement.strategy, no dso.workflow).
DSO_DEPRECATION_QUIET unset.
Assert: stderr is non-empty (contains deprecation text).

### test_dso_workflow_quiet_flag_suppresses_deprecation
Same config as above. DSO_DEPRECATION_QUIET=1.
Assert: stderr is empty (no deprecation warning).

### test_dso_workflow_contradictory_legacy_keys_returns_local
Config has `merge.strategy=pr` and `enforcement.strategy=local`.
Assert: stdout == "local", exit 0.

## Done Definition
All test functions exist in test-read-config.sh. Running `bash tests/run-all.sh` shows these tests FAILING (RED state confirmed — current read-config.sh returns empty/exit 0 for dso.workflow).
data.title: RED: Write failing tests for dso.workflow shim in read-config.sh
